record.question: From the following, which state has the lowest literacy rate in the northeastern state?
record.explanation: Census 2011 literacy: Manipur about 79.9%, Nagaland about 80.1%, Sikkim about 82.2%, Mizoram about 91.6%. Manipur is the lowest, although the Manipur-Nagaland gap is narrow.
